about_the_game:
Rise to King Ortler is a turn-based, family-friendly board game with elements of strategy and randomness – inspired by classics like Ludo, but with far more interaction and variety. Move your characters across dynamic game boards, use items, and master unique maps with their own rules and effects.

In campaign mode, you'll gradually unlock 8 different maps – each featuring new mechanics and challenges. Once unlocked, these maps become available in Free Play mode, where you can fully customize your match: Choose the number of players (1–4), assign human or AI opponents, and select your preferred map.

A special feature is the built-in name editor, allowing you to give your characters custom names to bring your matches to life.

🔑 Key Features

  • 🧠 Turn-based board game with elements of strategy and randomness

  • 🗺️ 8 unlockable maps with unique rules and special tiles

  • 🎲 Items and events that dynamically change the course of the game

  • 🧍‍♂️ Up to 4 human or AI players in local multiplayer (including Remote Play Together)

  • ✏️ Custom character naming via the integrated name editor

  • 👪 Family-friendly visuals – colorful, humorous, and featuring lighthearted fantasy action
